page_empty_day: Nothing captured. Press {hotkey} to write a note.
page_delete_description: It is removed from its day file. There is no undo.
capture_hint: Ctrl+Enter to save, Esc to dismiss
status_loading_hint: Loading the model into memory. The first note after launch or after an idle unload waits for this, then labelling starts.
status_enriching_hint: The model is writing a subject, summary and tags for new or edited notes, one at a time, in the background.
status_enriching_progress_hint: The model is writing a subject, summary and tags for note {current} of {total}, one at a time, in the background.
status_absent_hint: Notes are saved but not labelled until a model is installed. Pick one in Settings.
status_downloading_hint: The model is downloading. Notes captured meanwhile are queued and labelled once it is ready.
status_idle_hint: The model was unloaded after sitting idle, to free memory. It loads again with the next note.
status_ready_hint: The model is in memory with nothing left to do. New and edited notes are labelled within seconds.
status_disabled_hint: The model is turned off in Settings. Notes are saved and searchable, and wait to be labelled until it is back on. Chat is unavailable.
model_default_note: Qwen3 4B. Better labels, wants more RAM.
model_light_note: Qwen3 1.7B. Quicker, kinder to a small machine.
onboarding_downloading_body: Capture keeps working. Notes stay pending until this finishes.
onboarding_absent_body: Notes are saved and searchable without one. A model adds a subject, a summary and tags.
note_edit_hint: Ctrl+Enter to save, Esc to cancel
note_manual_title: Edited by hand, the model leaves it alone
search_chat_title: Chat with the model about this space. It reads the space index only: dates, subjects, summaries and tags.
search_chat_disabled: Chatting needs a model. Pick one in Settings.
search_chat_model_off: Chatting needs the model, which is turned off in Settings.
chat_intro: Ask anything about the notes in {space}. The model reads this space's index only: each note's date, subject, summary and tags. It does not see what the notes say.
chat_suggestion_week: What did I write about this week?
chat_suggestion_watched: Which movies and shows did I watch?
chat_suggestion_todo: What do I still need to do?
chat_send_title: Send (Enter). Shift+Enter for a new line.
editor_description: Changing the subject, category or tags takes the note over: the model will not relabel it.
editor_empty: A note cannot be empty. Delete it instead.
editor_uncategorised_hint: Click the selected one again to leave the note uncategorised.
spaces_trash_hint: Its folder is moved to {trash}. Move it back under {spaces} to restore it.
settings_general_description: Where your notes live and how you capture them.
settings_root_hint: One markdown file per day lives here.
settings_restart_needed: Saved. Restart Scratchnote to switch from {path}.
settings_hotkey_hint: Opens the capture window from anywhere.
settings_hide_on: The capture window closes as soon as a note is saved.
settings_hide_off: The capture window shows "Saved" for a second first.
settings_login_hint: Start Scratchnote when you sign in.
settings_appearance_description: Language, colors and sizes. Changes apply right away.
settings_font_hint: The typeface of the interface and your notes.
settings_text_size_hint: Scales the whole interface, notes included.
settings_radius_hint: How rounded cards, buttons and inputs are.
settings_model_description: The local model that tags and enriches your notes.
settings_model_enabled_hint: Turn it off on a machine too small to run it. Notes are then saved but not labelled, and chat is unavailable.
settings_model_custom_missing: The custom file is missing, so notes stay pending.
settings_model_none: No model installed. Notes stay pending until one is.
settings_update_hint: Look for a newer revision of this model.
settings_gpu_none: No supported GPU found, so the model runs on the CPU.
settings_gpu_found: {devices}. Much faster and lighter on the CPU.
settings_idle_hint: Frees its memory; the next note loads it again. 0 keeps it loaded.
settings_aliases_description: A tag on the left is written as the tag on the right, for new tags and for #tag searches in the open space. Each space keeps its own aliases. Tags already in your notes are not rewritten.
settings_aliases_empty_hint: Map k8s to kubernetes, js to javascript, and so on.
settings_index_description: The search index is only a cache of your markdown files. Each space has its own; these act on the open one.
settings_rebuild_hint: Reparse every daily file. Always safe to run.

match.countPlural=one: Index rebuilt from the markdown: {count} note.
match.countPlural=other: Index rebuilt from the markdown: {count} notes.

settings_regenerate_hint: Clears the subject, summary and tags of every note in the open space, hand edits included, then runs the model again on each one. The tag list starts empty and fills back in as notes are done. This cannot be undone, and it takes a while on a large journal.

match.countPlural=one: {count} note queued. The model works through it in the background.
match.countPlural=other: {count} notes queued. The model works through them in the background.
